'''Yavid''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and cousin of [[Markl]] who lived on [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Sometime before the war, he and his cousin left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and eventually found work on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where they worked in forestry. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], they accompanied [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and Agent [[Varrak]] on a mission to Lanteeb. There, they managed to create false identities for [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. After assisting the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], they returned to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
